assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and dizziness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is warranted, coded CPT 93229
The purpose is to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity and to optimize rate and rhythm control strategies
The payer denied the claim under PR-204
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan
The clinical indication explicitly documents the symptomatic presentation requiring correlation of arrhythmic activity
